metadata.label: negative
metadata.reference: A photorealistic art gallery room with a single large window on the left wall, featuring a central marble pedestal with a classical statue and a framed canvas leaning against the right wall, where the statue casts a shadow to the right but the leaning canvas casts a shadow to the left, no text, high detail.
metadata.rationale: Objects on the same side of a single window cast shadows toward opposite directions, which is impossible under one light source.
